literal_meaning: বুকে হাত রেখে বলা (saying with hand on the chest)
figurative_meaning_en: To act in accordance with one's conscience
similar_in_english: Cross my heart and hope to die
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি বুকে হাত দিয়ে বললেন যে কখনো মিথ্যা বলেননি।
বিবেকের কথা মেনে চলতে হলে বুকে হাত দিয়ে বলতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He said with his hand on his chest that he had never lied.
To follow one's conscience, one must speak with hand on heart.
note: This idiom emphasizes sincerity and moral integrity in Bengali expressions.
